name: Paruppu Rasam
steps: Cook the toor dal with turmeric until very soft; mash it smooth and reserve its cooking liquid.
Boil chopped tomatoes with tamarind water, rasam powder and salt until the tomatoes lose their raw taste.
Stir in the dal and enough reserved liquid to make a light broth; heat only until a foamy layer rises.
Temper mustard, cumin, red chilli and curry leaves in ghee, pour over the rasam and finish with coriander.
tips: The dal gives this rasam body; dilute it enough to pour easily over rice.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
